literal: Hidden things to listen capable having become, known things doubt without-indeed (is) a spy.
translation: A true spy is capable of uncovering hidden secrets and harbors no doubts about the information they have gathered.
modern: மறைக்கப்பட்ட செய்திகளை ஒற்றறிந்து கேட்கும் திறமை உடையவனாகி, அவ்வாறு அறிந்த செய்திகளில் எந்த சந்தேகமும் இல்லாதவனே சிறந்த ஒற்றன் ஆவான்.
explanation: This couplet defines the two essential qualities of a competent spy. First, they must have the skill to uncover and listen to closely guarded secrets. Second, the intelligence they gather must be verified so thoroughly that there is absolutely no room for doubt. Only someone who possesses both this investigative capacity and absolute certainty in their findings is considered a true spy.
